e.title: 一个「谁在用」写得比「它做什么」更清楚的系统：**邀请制、多租户、给某位代理人本人与约十位互信的朋友**、**每个用户的数据完全隔离**，而它是一部**真实在跑的**保单持有人 CRM 的源码——却**没有任何许可文件、也没有数据保护声明**
e.title_en: A system that describes who uses it more precisely than what it does — invite-only, multi-tenant, for one named agent and about ten trusted friends, with each user’s data fully isolated — and it is the source of a live policyholder CRM with no licence file and no data-protection statement
e.title_hk: 一個「誰在用」寫得比「它做什麼」更清楚的系統：**邀請制、多租戶、給某位代理人本人與約十位互信的朋友**、**每個用戶的數據完全隔離**，而它是一部**真實在跑的**保單持有人 CRM 的源碼——卻**沒有任何許可文件、也沒有數據保護聲明**
e.summary: 一份**马来西亚回教保险（takaful）代理人的客户关系管理系统**：自述为「**私人的、邀请制的多租户 CRM**」（**并点名其面向的是一家真实保险公司的回教保险代理人**），**部署在一个真实域名上**，**用 Laravel 12 ＋ MySQL ＋ Blade ＋ Alpine.js v3 ＋ Tailwind CSS v3 写成**；**其最值得记的一处是它对「谁在用」的界定比「它做什么」更具体**——**逐字为「一份给 Hana 与**最多约十位互信的朋友**的私人 CRM（AIA takaful agents）。**每个用户的数据完全隔离**。管理**保单持有人、线索、外联互动、展业策略，以及一个用于分享 AI 生成内容与计划产品知识的**双边市场**」**，**并逐字署名**「Built by Hana · AIA Public Takaful · Dr Takaful brand」**——**⭐ 即**使用者范围（一个人加约十个人）、隔离方式（数据完全隔离）、以及业务归属（一个具名品牌）三件事都被明确写出**；**另有三处可核实特征**：**① `README` 的主体是一份**带日期的业务功能变更日志****（**其中一节逐字为「2026-06-05 — Sales Loop Closed（Priority 1 complete）」，并逐条列出**线索→客户的内联转换（含 `converted_at` 与「Converted Lead」徽章）、报价与线索或客户的关联（可空外键＋可选下拉）、以及外联触点的策略标记（`strategy_id` 可空外键＋「Strategy Used」下拉）**）**——**⭐ 即**它的版本记录按**业务能力**而不是技术版本编号**；**② 这是**一部真实在跑的业务系统的源码**（**其根目录自述部署于一个真实域名**）；**③ ⚠️⚠️ 而它**没有任何许可文件**，**README 中也没有数据保护或隐私声明**——**⭐ 本词条把这三件事分开写：**技术形态**、**谁在用**、**以及使用者应当自己确认的两件事（可否复用、以及其中数据的状态）****
e.summary_hk: 一份**馬來西亞回教保險（takaful）代理人的客戶關係管理系統**：自述為「**私人的、邀請制的多租戶 CRM**」（**並點名其面向的是一家真實保險公司的回教保險代理人**），**部署在一個真實域名上**，**用 Laravel 12 ＋ MySQL ＋ Blade ＋ Alpine.js v3 ＋ Tailwind CSS v3 寫成**；**其最值得記的一處是它對「誰在用」的界定比「它做什麼」更具體**——**逐字為「一份給 Hana 與**最多約十位互信的朋友**的私人 CRM（AIA takaful agents）。**每個用戶的數據完全隔離**。管理**保單持有人、線索、外聯互動、展業策略，以及一個用於分享 AI 生成內容與計劃產品知識的**雙邊市場**」**，**並逐字署名**「Built by Hana · AIA Public Takaful · Dr Takaful brand」**——**⭐ 即**使用者範圍（一個人加約十個人）、隔離方式（數據完全隔離）、以及業務歸屬（一個具名品牌）三件事都被明確寫出**；**另有三處可核實特徵**：**① `README` 的主體是一份**帶日期的業務功能變更日誌****（**其中一節逐字為「2026-06-05 — Sales Loop Closed（Priority 1 complete）」，並逐條列出**線索→客戶的內聯轉換（含 `converted_at` 與「Converted Lead」徽章）、報價與線索或客戶的關聯（可空外鍵＋可選下拉）、以及外聯觸點的策略標記（`strategy_id` 可空外鍵＋「Strategy Used」下拉）**）**——**⭐ 即**它的版本記錄按**業務能力**而不是技術版本編號**；**② 這是**一部真實在跑的業務系統的源碼**（**其根目錄自述部署於一個真實域名**）；**③ ⚠️⚠️ 而它**沒有任何許可文件**，**README 中也沒有數據保護或隱私聲明**——**⭐ 本詞條把這三件事分開寫：**技術形態**、**誰在用**、**以及使用者應當自己確認的兩件事（可否複用、以及其中數據的狀態）****
e.summary_en: A customer relationship management system for a Malaysian takaful agent, self-described as a private invite-only multi-tenant CRM and naming the real insurer whose agents it is for, deployed at a real domain and built with Laravel 12, MySQL, Blade, Alpine.js and Tailwind CSS; **its most notable feature is that it describes who uses it more precisely than what it does** — verbatim, it is a private CRM for a named individual and about ten trusted friends, with **each user’s data fully isolated**, managing **policyholders, leads, outreach interactions, prospecting strategy, and a two-sided marketplace for sharing AI-generated content and plan product knowledge** — and it signs itself verbatim with the builder’s name, the insurer and the brand; **so the user range (one person plus about ten), the isolation model (data fully isolated) and the business affiliation (a named brand) are all stated explicitly**; **three further checkable features**: **first, the README’s body is a dated log of business features**, one entry reading verbatim as sales loop closed with priority one complete and listing an inline lead-to-client conversion carrying a conversion timestamp and a converted-lead badge, an optional link between quotations and leads or clients via nullable foreign keys, and strategy tagging on outreach touchpoints — **so its versioning is by business capability rather than by technical release**; **second, it is the source code of a live business system, the root describing deployment at a real domain**; **and third, ⚠️⚠️ it has no licence file at all and its README carries no data-protection or privacy statement** — ⭐ **so the entry keeps three things apart: the technical shape, who uses it, and the two things a reader must confirm for themselves, namely whether the code may be reused and what state any data inside it is in**
e.body:
**drtakaful-agent-crm**（仓库 `farahanasuhaimi/cms-takaful`，自述名为 Dr Takaful CMS）**是一份马来西亚回教保险（takaful）代理人的客户关系管理系统**：**自述为** **「Private invite-only multi-tenant CRM for Malaysian takaful agents（**AIA Public Takaful**）」**，**并逐字写明其部署域名**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 **Blade**、仓库体量 867 KB、创建 2026-04-14、最后推送 2026-09-10、无 topics、无 homepage 字段**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建在解冻窗口之前，推送落在窗口之内**）；**README 实测 11,392 字节**；**仓库实测共 352 个条目（284 个文件、68 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「按部分声明：许可、能力、交付物与使用者各自适用什么规则」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**唯一把**使用者**这一维度写到最具体的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「谁在用」被写得比「它做什么」更具体**——**这是本条最值得单独记的一处，也是本轮主题在**使用者**维度上最完整的一例**：**其 README 逐字为**：**「> **Private invite-only multi-tenant CRM** for Malaysian takaful agents（**AIA Public Takaful**）. > **Deployed at: `list.drtakaful.com`** > Built with: **Laravel 12 · MySQL · Blade · Alpine.js v3 · Tailwind CSS v3**」**；**并逐字说明使用者范围与隔离方式**：**「**A private CRM for Hana and up to ~10 trusted friends（AIA takaful agents）. Each user’s data is fully isolated.** Manages **policyholders, leads, outreach interactions, prospecting strategy, and a two-sided marketplace for sharing AI-generated content and plan product knowledge**.」**；**并逐字署名**：**「**Built by Hana · AIA Public Takaful · Dr Takaful brand**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **使用者范围的**数量级被写出**（**一个人 ＋ 最多约十位互信的朋友**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**对「这个系统给谁用」写得最不含糊的一处**：**多数项目写「面向团队」或「面向企业」，**而它给出了一个**约十人的上限****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **隔离方式被写成一句可核对的断言**（**逐字「Each user’s data is fully isolated」，**每个用户的数据完全隔离**）**——**⭐ 即**「多租户」不只是标签，**而是**一条被声明的性质****（**⚠️ 但**本词条**未核实**其实现，**见标注 ③**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **它点名了**所面向的真实保险公司与品牌****（**并逐字署名建造者**）**——**⭐ 本词条**只如实转述其自述，**不主张**该公司对该项目有任何关系、认可或参与**（**⚠️ 亦**未核实**该署名的真实性**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **业务范围逐项列出，其中一项是一个**小范围的双边市场****（**逐字「a **two-sided marketplace** for sharing **AI-generated content and plan product knowledge**」**）**——**⭐ 即**在一个约十人的封闭群体内做一个内容与产品知识的交换场所****。**② ⭐⭐ **其 README 的主体是一份**带日期的业务功能变更日志****——**逐字其中一节的标题为** **「### **2026-06-05 — Sales Loop Closed（Priority 1 complete）**」**，**并逐条列出三项**：**① **线索 → 客户的转换**（**Leads 页上的内联「Convert」按钮；从线索数据创建客户、迁移全部接触点、标记 `converted_at`；客户档案上显示「Converted Lead」徽章**）**；**② **报价与线索或客户的关联**（**`lead_id` 与 `client_id` 为可空外键；创建与编辑表单上有可选的「Link to Lead or Client」下拉；关联到的名字显示在报价详情与索引上**）**；**③ **接触点的策略标记**（**`strategy_id` 为可空外键；所有接触点记录表单上有可选的「Strategy Used」下拉；策略显示在互动历史与跟进列表中**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **它的「版本记录」按**业务能力**编号**（**逐字「Priority 1 complete」「Sales Loop Closed」**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「v1.2.3 修了什么」，**而是**「销售闭环已打通」****；**② ⭐⭐ **三条都给出了**数据层面的实现要点**（**`converted_at`、`lead_id`／`client_id` 可空外键、`strategy_id` 可空外键**）**——**⭐ 即**业务变更与技术变更被一起写****；**③ **外键被写成**可空**这一细节值得注意**（**⭐ 即**报价**可以**不关联到线索或客户**——**这是一个**允许缺省的设计**）；**④ **它用**日期**给每条变更定位**（**2026-06-05**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **它是一部**真实在跑的业务系统的源码**，而这带来两件必须分开写的事**——**其根目录自述部署于一个真实域名**（**实测 README 逐字含 `Deployed at: list.drtakaful.com`**）**，**而 ⚠️ 其业务范围逐字含**保单持有人（policyholders）****⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **本词条**不核实**其部署是否仍在运行，**亦**未访问**该域名**；**② ⚠️⚠️ **本词条**未核实**该仓库中是否含任何真实客户个人信息**——**⭐ 本次**未读任何数据文件、未读任何迁移或种子、未做任何数据库检查****；**故**本词条**既不主张**它含有真实信息，**也不主张**它不含**（**⭐ 这一点对读者很重要：**这是一部面向保单持有人的系统，**若含真实数据则其公开状态值得注意；**本词条只把问题标出，不作判断****）；**③ ⚠️⚠️ **README 中**未见**数据保护或隐私声明**（**本词条以「PDPA」「compliance」「data privacy」等词检索其 README，**未命中**）**——**⭐ 本词条**不主张**这构成问题**（**⚠️ 未写声明**不等于**处理不当**），**只如实指出：**读者无从据此判断其数据处理方式****；**④ **许可为 **NONE****（**见标注 ①**）**——**⭐ 即**「可否复用其代码」以及「其中的数据处于什么状态」是**两件读者必须各自确认的事****。**④ ⭐ **其技术栈被逐项写明**：**`Laravel 12 · MySQL · Blade · Alpine.js v3 · Tailwind CSS v3`**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① **五个组件都带**主版本号****（**Laravel 12、Alpine.js v3、Tailwind v3**）**——**⭐ 即**版本被钉住而不是写「最新」**；**② ⭐⭐ **其 GitHub 主语言被判为 **Blade****（**一个模版语言**）**——**⭐ 本词条指出这是一个**不常见的主语言判定结果**，**⭐ 且它**与该 README 的技术栈自述一致**（**⭐ 即**该判定**并非噪声**，**而是反映**视图层占了文件数的大头****）。**⑤ ⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **实测根目录含 `LICENSE`？**——**⚠️ 不含**（**实测其 352 个条目中**无 `LICENSE` 文件**，**与 API 返回的 **NONE** 一致**）；**② **其 README 结构为「半页说明 ＋ 一份按日期排列的变更列表」**（**⭐ 即**文档是**活的****）；**③ **其仓库体量 867 KB、284 个文件**（**⭐ 与其「一个人加约十个人」的使用规模相比，**代码量并不小****）。**⑥ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[islamic-banking-platform]]、[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]]、[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为 **NONE****——**实测仓库**无任何许可文件**（**352 个条目中不含 `LICENSE`**），**README 亦无许可章节**；**⚠️ 故**本词条**不主张**其代码、模版、迁移或任何内容可在任何条件下使用**，**且**⚠️ 本词条特别提示**：**这是一部**真实业务系统**的源码**，**有意借鉴或复用者**应先向作者确认授权**。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未运行该系统的任何一步****——**未克隆、未安装 PHP 或 Composer、未建 MySQL、未运行迁移或种子、未启动应用、未登录、**未访问其自述的部署域名**；**故**本词条**不主张**其系统可用、其「数据完全隔离」确实成立、其「双边市场」可用、或其变更日志所列功能确实已实现**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与仓库的文件结构**（**352 个条目、284 个文件**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何源码、视图、迁移、种子或数据文件的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**完全未核对**：**多租户隔离是否确实在查询层实现**（**⚠️ 这是本条最需要后续核实的一处**——**⭐ 这是一条**安全相关的断言**，**而它在本条里**只有 README 作依据**）；**`converted_at`／`lead_id`／`client_id`／`strategy_id` 这些字段是否确实存在**；**那条「线索 → 客户」的转换是否确实迁移全部接触点**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**该仓库是否含任何真实个人信息**——**⭐ 这一点在本条尤其重要**（**其业务范围逐字含**保单持有人**，**且是一部在跑的 CRM**）：**本词条**未读任何数据文件、未读任何种子或迁移、未做数据库检查**；**故**既不主张含**、**也不主张不含**；**⚠️ 有意使用者应在使用前自行确认**。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其数据处理是否符合马来西亚或任何其他法域的数据保护要求**——**⚠️ 本词条**未查任何法规**，**亦**未在 README 中找到数据保护声明**；**⭐ 本词条**不主张**未写声明即等于处理不当，**只指出这一点无从判断****。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其自述的署名人（**Hana**）、所点名的保险公司与品牌（**AIA Public Takaful／Dr Takaful**）与该项目的实际关系**——**⭐ 本词条**只如实转述其自述**，**不主张**该公司认可、参与或知情**；**⚠️ 亦**不主张**其署名为真**。**⑦ ⚠️ **未核实**其部署域名是否仍在运行或由谁运营**。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其可用于任何真实的代理业务、客户管理或合规用途**。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者身份、资历或该系统的实际使用情况**。**⑩ ⭐ **★0、fork 0、无 topics**，**关注度为零**，**不主张其成熟度**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 本词条指出：**其 README **达 11,392 字节**，**而其中**大部分是一份**带日期的业务变更日志****——**⭐ 即**一份**按业务能力生长**的文档**，**而不是产品介绍**；**应如实写出，不用星数代替判断****。**⑪ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-04-14）****——**⭐ 如实记录该日期，**其入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）**；**⚠️ 本词条另指出：**该仓库**自 4 月创建以来持续推送**，**故其**是一份**仍在生长的**系统****。**⑫ ⚠️ **文档为**英文****（**其自述为英文，**业务语境为马来西亚**）**——**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**其是否另有马来语或中文文档**。**⑬ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****——**该仓库持续推送**，**其变更日志与内容会变动**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/farahanasuhaimi/cms-takaful` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 NONE、★数、fork 数、语言 Blade、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；README 11,392 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**本词条据其头部三行、使用者说明、最近更新一节与署名行引用**）；**仓库全部 352 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**284 文件、68 目录；本词条据其核对根目录文件与是否存在 `LICENSE`**）；**未克隆、未安装 PHP 或 **drtakaful-agent-crm** (repository `farahanasuhaimi/cms-takaful`, self-named Dr Takaful CMS) **is a customer relationship management system for a Malaysian takaful agent**: **it describes itself as a private invite-only multi-tenant CRM for Malaysian takaful agents**, **naming the real insurer whose agents it is for**, and states its deployment domain verbatim. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **NONE** (the repository measurably has no licence file), detected primary language **Blade**, an 867 KB repository, created 2026-04-14, last pushed 2026-09-10, no topics and no homepage field** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 11,392 bytes**; **the repository measures 352 entries (284 files, 68 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **a system should be declared part by part, with each part’s applicable rules stated**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the only one that writes the user dimension most concretely**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① Who uses it is described more precisely than what it does** — **the most notable point in this entry and the most complete instance of this round’s theme along the user dimension**: **its README reads verbatim as a private invite-only multi-tenant CRM for Malaysian takaful agents, naming the insurer, giving the deployment domain and the stack — Laravel 12, MySQL, Blade, Alpine.js and Tailwind CSS**; **then states verbatim that it is a private CRM for a named individual and up to about ten trusted friends who are that insurer’s takaful agents, that each user’s data is fully isolated, and that it manages policyholders, leads, outreach interactions, prospecting strategy and a two-sided marketplace for sharing AI-generated content and plan product knowledge**; **and signs itself verbatim with the builder’s name, the insurer and the brand** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the user range is given as an order of magnitude — one person plus at most about ten trusted friends — the least ambiguous account this round of who a system is for, where most projects say "for teams" or "for enterprises" and this one gives a ceiling of about ten**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the isolation model is stated as a checkable assertion, that each user’s data is fully isolated, so multi-tenancy is not merely a label but a declared property** (⚠️ **whose implementation was not verified**); ⭐⭐ **it names the real insurer and brand it is for and signs the builder verbatim, which this entry restates as the repository’s own account without claiming that the company has any relationship to, endorsement of, or involvement in the project, and without verifying the attribution**; **and ⭐⭐ the business scope is itemised, one part of it being a small closed two-sided marketplace for content and product knowledge among about ten people**. **② ⭐⭐ The README’s body is a dated log of business features** — one section heading reads verbatim as **sales loop closed, priority one complete, dated**, and lists three items: **an inline lead-to-client conversion** with a convert button on the leads page, creating a client from lead data, migrating all touchpoints, marking a conversion timestamp and showing a converted-lead badge; **an optional link between quotations and leads or clients** through nullable foreign keys with an optional dropdown and the linked name shown on the quotation detail and index; **and strategy tagging on touchpoints** through a nullable foreign key with an optional dropdown and the strategy shown in interaction history and follow-up lists ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **its versioning is by business capability rather than technical release, reading as priority one complete and the sales loop closed rather than as a version number and a list of fixes**; ⭐⭐ **each item gives its data-level implementation detail, so business changes and technical changes are written together**; **the foreign keys are nullable, meaning a quotation may legitimately have no lead or client attached, which is a design that permits absence**; **and each change is dated**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ It is the source code of a live business system, which raises two things that must be written separately** — **the root states verbatim that it is deployed at a real domain**, ⚠️ **and its business scope includes policyholders** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **this entry does not verify whether that deployment still runs, and did not visit that domain**; ⚠️⚠️ **it does not verify whether the repository contains any real customer personal information, since no data file, migration or seed was read and no database check was made, so it claims neither that such data is present nor that it is absent** (⭐ **which matters here, since this is a system for policyholders and a public repository holding real data would warrant attention; the entry marks the question without judging it**); ⚠️⚠️ **no data-protection or privacy statement was found in the README**, the terms for data protection, compliance and data privacy having been searched without a hit, ⭐ **and the entry does not claim this constitutes a problem, since not writing a statement is not the same as mishandling data, but notes that a reader cannot judge the data handling from it**; **and the licence is NONE, so whether the code may be reused and what state any data inside it is in are two things a reader must confirm separately**. **④ ⭐ Its stack is itemised with major versions** — Laravel 12, MySQL, Blade, Alpine.js v3 and Tailwind CSS v3 ⭐⭐ **Two things**: **all five components carry a major version, so versions are pinned rather than described as latest**; **and ⭐⭐ its detected primary language is Blade, a templating language, an unusual detection result that nevertheless agrees with the README’s own stack statement, so the detection is not noise but reflects the view layer accounting for most of the files**. **⑤ ⭐ Other checkable details**: **no licence file appears among its 352 entries, consistent with the API reading of NONE**; **its README is half a page of description plus a dated change list, so the documentation is alive**; **and at 867 KB and 284 files the codebase is not small relative to a user base of one person plus about ten**. **⑥ ⭐ Readable with** [[islamic-banking-platform]], [[bnm-insurance-takaful]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[brokerflow-renewal-crm]], [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]], [[application-fill-provenance]], [[policy-explainer-ai]] and [[insurance-governance]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️ Licence measured as NONE** — **the repository measurably has no licence file, none appearing among its 352 entries, and the README has no licence section**; ⚠️ **so no claim is made that its code, templates, migrations or any content may be used under any conditions, and the entry notes especially that this is the source of a real business system, so anyone intending to borrow or reuse it should confirm authorisation with the author first**. **② ⚠️⚠️ No step of the system was run** — **nothing was cloned, no PHP or Composer was installed, no MySQL was created, no migration or seed was run, the application was not started, no login was attempted, and the deployment domain it names was not visited**; **so the system is not claimed to work, its full data isolation is not claimed to hold, its marketplace is not claimed to function, and the features its change log lists are not claimed to be implemented** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and the repository’s file structure**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No source, view, migration, seed or data file was read** — ⭐ **so nothing at all was checked about whether multi-tenant isolation is really implemented at the query layer, which is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry because it is a security-related assertion supported here only by the README; whether the named fields really exist; and whether the lead-to-client conversion really migrates all touchpoints**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Whether the repository contains any real personal information was not verified** — ⭐ **which matters especially here, since the business scope includes policyholders and this is a running CRM; no data file, seed or migration was read and no database check was made, so the entry claims neither presence nor absence, and ⚠️ anyone intending to use it should establish this for themselves first**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ Whether its data handling satisfies Malaysian or any other jurisdiction’s data-protection requirements was not verified** — ⚠️ **no regulation was consulted and no data-protection statement was found in the README**; ⭐ **the entry does not claim that the absence of a statement means mishandling, only that the question cannot be settled from it**. **⑥ ⚠️ The actual relationship between the named individual, the named insurer and brand, and this project was not verified** — ⭐ **the entry restates the repository’s own account and makes no claim that the company endorses, participates in or knows of it**. **⑦ ⚠️ Whether the deployment domain still runs, and who operates it, was not verified**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made that it is usable for any real agency business, client management or compliance purpose**. **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Its author’s identity, background and the system’s actual usage were not verified**. **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks and no topics**, **attention is zero**, **so no maturity is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ its README measures 11,392 bytes and most of that is a dated log of business changes — documentation that grows by business capability rather than a product description**, **which the site records rather than letting star counts stand in for judgement**. **⑪ ⚠️ It was created before the thaw window, on 2026-04-14** — ⭐ **recorded as such, with selection resting on the push falling inside the window (2026-09-10)**; ⭐ **and since it has been pushed continuously since April, it is a system still growing**. **⑫ ⚠️ The documentation is in English**, **the business context being Malaysian** — ⚠️ **whether Malay or Chinese documentation also exists was not verified**. **⑬ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11** — **and the repository is pushed continuously, so its change log and contents will keep changing**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/farahanasuhaimi/cms-takaful` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence NONE, stars, forks, language Blade, size, created/pushed dates and topics);
